metadata.comment: QueryCoreDebitStatus -> the indeterminate debit DID execute (Document 05 Scenario C; bd babelstone-t7o3.10). The clearance query asked Core 'was this debit actually executed?' and the answer is yes -- so a LATE DebitConfirmed resumes the happy path (the saga walks AWAIT_CORE_CLEARANCE -> APPROVED, arming ActivateDeposit). Default clearance answer (priority 5); the not-executed mapping (debits-clearance-not-executed) overrides it on a marker. The 2xx=executed encoding is a v1 STUB CONVENTION -- DEF-1's real ACL emits typed clearance events instead (ADR-IC-003 Amendment 2026-06-14, extended for Scenario C).
